0x000037.en:
An era known as the New Calendar.
Roughly two centuries had passed since humanity first ventured
into space in earnest, yet daily life had changed little from the early 21st century.

0x000112.en:
This was because human progress had temporarily stalled due to the
damage and chaos wrought by two meteors that fell to Earth in the Old Calendar era.

0x0001BD.en:
Then, in New Calendar 179,
a third meteor, "Meteor 3," fell on the Isle of Aidoneus.

0x000232.en:
Dr. Bian Zoldark, who investigated Meteor 3, became convinced
that it was an artificial object, deliberately dropped
to Earth by some unknown will.

0x0002F6.en:
For Meteor 3 had appeared suddenly in the L5 region, then
fell to Earth... and was found to have decelerated before impact.
Moreover, sealed inside it, clearly meant to be found and examined,
were substances and technical data unknown to humanity.

0x00044E.en:
These were called Extra-Over Technology... "EOT."
Under the strict information control of the "EOT Special Council,"
formed by top Earth Federation officials, and the "EOTI Agency"
headed by Bian, further study proceeded.

0x000594.en:
And when data was found on articulated mobile weapons over 10
meters long, apparently used by some party... namely extraterrestrial
intelligent life, Bian grew deeply wary of them.

0x00069A.en:
Bian speculated on the aliens' purpose in giving humanity EOT,
and judged there was a high chance that invasion was built
into the process leading to that goal.

0x000779.en:
He warned the Federation government and military of the threat
of invasion by the aliens, code-named "Aerogaters."
Taking it gravely, Maj. Gen. Norman Sleigh proposed a plan to defend
the Earth sphere. Development began on the "Personal Trooper," a humanoid
mobile weapon capable of fighting the Aerogaters...

0x00092C.en:
New Calendar 186.
Ryusei Date was competing in the "Burning PT" championship, a versus
robot action game, when the venue was suddenly attacked by unknown mobile weapons...

0x000A73.en:
Maj. Ingram Prisken, central figure of the SRX Project underway at the
Federation's Izu base as part of the Earth defense plan, noticed Ryusei's
talent and schemed to draw him in. Like it or not, Ryusei became a test
pilot of a Personal Trooper (PT).

0x000C25.en:
At the Federation's Antarctic Coatland base, a ceremony was about to be held
to unveil the Shirogane, first ship of the Spacenoah-class multipurpose
battle carrier, and the humanoid weapon Granzon developed by the EOTI Agency.
In truth, it was a peace talk with the aliens "Guests" disguised as a ceremony...

0x000E01.en:
Dr. Shu Shirakawa, one of Granzon's developers, suddenly attacked the Guests,
then turned on the Federation as well, annihilating Coatland base. Right after,
the EOTI Agency led by Dr. Bian Zoldark named itself the "Divine Crusaders (DC)"
and raised its banner in revolt against the Earth Federation government.

0x000FD0.en:
With the uprising of the DC and the allied Colony Integration Army, the world
was engulfed in war. Through blitz operations using the mobile weapon "Armored
Module (AM)," the DC seized military strongpoints across the Earth sphere.
Meanwhile Ryusei met Tenzan Nakajima again in battle and rediscovered why he fights.

0x001190.en: To break the deadlock, Izu base commander Laker Randolph ordered Lt. Col.\nDaitetsu Minase to launch a direct assault on DC headquarters with the Hagane.\nAs the Hagane prepared to launch, a DC unit led by Rai's brother Elzam attacked Izu base...

0x00130A.en:
In a desperate situation from an incoming large missile, Ryusei succeeded in
activating the R-1 developed under the SRX Project. Escaping danger, the Hagane
set course for the Isle of Aidoneus. Then Masaki Andoh, pilot of the Cybuster
who had saved the SRX team in Antarctica, appeared. To track down Shu, he
accepted the Hagane's offer of joint battle.

0x001501.en:
The group joined up with Jonathan, who had escaped Langley base. As they received
the Grungust, they learned that former instructor corps member Sanger Zonvolt had
defected to the DC. Among the enemies attacking to stop the Hagane's advance was
Ryoto Hikawa. Learning he had only been used by the DC as a captive, he resolved
to fight the DC alongside the Hagane.

0x00171B.en:
The Hagane began its operation to capture the DC fortress on the Isle of Aidoneus.
But the attack on the fortress core with the Tronium Buster Cannon failed, and
captain Daitetsu decided to send PT units to strike inside the fortress.

0x001871.en:
A deadly battle against the Valsion and Granzon waiting at the fortress core.
Bian entrusted Earth's future to Masaki and the others, and fell.

0x001950.en:
After the decisive battle on Aidoneus, the Hagane received a distress signal and
rushed to the Principality of Rikasent, a Federation special zone on the Mediterranean.
It drove off DC remnants and rescued Princess Shine.

0x001A6A.en:
The Hagane returned to Izu base with Princess Shine. There, awaiting Ryusei and the
SRX team was a mock battle against the ATX team led by Kyosuke Nanbu, test pilot of
the ATX Project developing assault-use humanoid weapons...

0x001C10.en:
Through the fight, both teams came to acknowledge each other's skill. Around the same
time, the alien Aerogaters' giant fortress "White Star" appeared in the L5 region.
The Hiryu Kai, sent to observe it, was attacked by small mobile weapons. The threat
Dr. Bian had hinted at before his death became reality.

0x001DB1.en:
Before the Hagane and Hiryu Kai, dispatched near the L5 region, appeared Bian's
daughter Lune. She chose to fight the aliens alongside Masaki, and Rai's cousin Leona
left the DC remnants and pledged to aid the Federation. Around then, Aerogater leader
Levi Tolar issued a demand for surrender to the Earth Federation government.

0x001F83.en:
At Izu base, Commander Laker's absence was exploited and Princess Shine was abducted.
DC remnants led by Adler Koch used the chaos of the Aerogaters' appearance to move on
seizing Geneva. Former instructor corps member Tempest Hawker, who appeared to delay
the Hagane, had his mind collapse from the side effects of the Valsion Kai's Geim System.

0x0021A4.en:
The Hagane and Hiryu Kai rushed to Geneva, but before them appeared Tenzan and a
Valsion Kai piloted by the mind-controlled Princess Shine. The group barely managed
to rescue Shine and defeat Tenzan. After the DC War, thanks also to help from the
long-missing Sanger, Adler's ambitions came to nothing.

0x00236C.en:
Heading for a drill ground in the China region to test the R-series with newly
rolled-out Plus Parts, the Hagane was suddenly confronted by a large Aerogater force.
Ingram ordered Ryusei and the others to combine into the SRX...

0x0024D8.en:
The Hagane's crew were shocked to learn that Ingram, who had fought alongside them,
was an Aerogater spy. Against Ingram's betrayal, Ryusei and the SRX team resolved
to settle things with their own hands.

0x002637.en:
As "Operation SRW," the assault on the Aerogaters' home base White Star planned by
Maj. Gen. Norman Sleigh of the Federation Joint Chiefs, drew near, Ingram appeared
once more. After a hard fight, Ryusei and the others finally succeeded in combining
into the SRX.

0x0027BE.en:
The Aerogaters had mind-controlled abducted humans and made them pilots of mobile
weapons. Meeting his end and regaining his memory, Garguin, the former instructor
corps captain Kar-Wai Lau, entrusted Earth's future to his old comrades.

0x002925.en:
With Operation SRW imminent, the Federation space fleet gathered in the L5 region.
At last the curtain rose on the decisive battle with the Aerogaters, and the all-out
assault on White Star began. Pressed by overwhelming enemy forces and cornered, the
Federation fleet carried out a mobile-force breakthrough into White Star.

0x002AEE.en:
Amid the crisis, Hagane's quick thinking pulls them from danger, and
Kurogane arrives with reinforcements as the group presses into the White
Star. At its core, Ingram waits to give them one final trial. His mission
was to manipulate information so Earth's forces would be drawn to the Aero-
gaters, and to seek out humans with special powers...

0x002CFB.en:
Having wrecked the core and escaped the White Star, the group faces Levi
Tolar, chieftain of the Aerogaters. After a fierce battle they destroy the
Judecca Levi pilots, but this breaks the seal on Meteor 3 at Aidoneus Island.

0x002E6B.en:
Hidden within Meteor 3 was the Aerogaters' final weapon, "Septuagint." It
was programmed to activate the moment humankind became a threat to their
own existence...

0x002FB0.en:
The battle is over, and peace returns to the world once more.
Those who fought together each begin to walk their own path...
